verdict.rationale: Secureframe's API and Custom Integrations feature lets you create and map custom resources from tools it doesn't natively integrate with. You push raw data through an API endpoint (or CSV), and Secureframe normalizes, maps and runs compliance tests on it. That covers the core of the story, though the evidence is marketing-level feature pages, not API reference docs. Missing for 10: detailed API reference (endpoints, auth, schemas), explicit support for pushing externally computed test results rather than raw data that Secureframe tests itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
